leads.title: dsh-game-studio
leads.desc: Describe a small game in one sentence, play it in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, swap in AI art, and publish to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare in one click.

leads.title: trompe
leads.desc: Texture a whole game level from a gray blockout with image models: plan cameras, paint, project, bake. Real shadows, glTF out.

leads.title: open-source-hands
leads.desc: Make webcam hand games in the browser, or point your coding agent here and have it make one. MediaPipe hand tracking + a gesture engine + a starter game + a playbook.

leads.title: resp-OldenEraExplorer

leads.title: forgeax-engine
leads.ai_hint: AI-native TypeScript game engine for AI agents, targeting all major platforms
leads.desc: AI-native TypeScript game engine for AI agents, targeting all major platforms. WebGPU rendering, ECS, procedural assets, and a CLI-first development workflow.

leads.title: DishwasherBench
leads.ai_hint: ai-agents benchmark evaluation game llm llm-benchmark mcp physics-simulation simulation typescript webgpu
leads.desc: A dishwasher-loading game on a physical simulation of one real machine, built to benchmark language models and playable in a browser. The game inside is called Spotless.

leads.title: rpocket-team-eyeproof
leads.desc: Eyes for coding agents, headless: screenshots, game play-tests, Blender renders and videos, measured, then looked at.

leads.title: seriesoftubes
leads.desc: A free cartoon browser game about how the internet really works: lay fiber and subsea cables, peer at IXPs, bill on the 95th percentile and survive backhoes, sharks and route leaks on your way to Tier 1.

leads.title: LGUI
leads.ai_hint: Game UI framework for AI agents, made by LumioGames
leads.desc: Game UI framework for AI agents, made by LumioGames. Build screens, logic and tests in the browser with no game engine, then export to Unity. 给 AI Agent 用的游戏 UI 框架，不依赖游戏引擎。

leads.title: PS4-Games-Installer
leads.desc: A game library manager for jailbroken PS4 consoles. Browse remote catalogs, install packages, launch games, and organize your collection.

leads.title: d2-web
leads.desc: Play Diablo II: Lord of Destruction in your browser — the 1.13c engine reimplemented in C++ and compiled to WebAssembly. Bring your own game files.

leads.title: tiny-game-agent
leads.desc: A tiny rule-based agent that plays a browser grid game

leads.title: bdo-viewer-resocket
leads.desc: Desktop companion to bdo-data-extractor: browse Black Desert items, recipes, knowledge, NPCs, with a cost-aware crafting calculator & gear builder. Wails3 + React. Fully local from your game files.

leads.title: librehold
leads.desc: A free, open-source browser strategy game: grow a settlement from a hut to a castle, raise an army, raid and conquer.

leads.title: rpocket-bhop

leads.title: rpocket-FxDeck

leads.title: bo1-zombies-coop

leads.title: dream-arcade-demo
